items.title: SEARCH
items.placementTarget: Back of each player reference card
items.text:
SEARCH
Scratch off one box on a City card in your hand if you are in the matching city. (You do not need to discard it.)

mechanics.trigger: You are in the city matching a City card in your hand
mechanics.effect: Scratch off one box on that City card.
restrictions: You must be in the matching city
The City card stays in your hand; you do not discard it
mechanics.parentheticalItalic: You do not need to discard it.

items.title: Reference card placement
items.text: Place this sticker on the back of each player reference card.

mechanics.effect: Place the action sticker on the back of each player reference card.

summary: Search action overlay: in the matching city, scratch one box on a City card in hand and do not discard it. Place it on the back of each player reference card. The door numeral is printed rotated 90° counter-clockwise. The placement strip is byte-identical to doors 37 and 38.
